item.title: Nozawa Onsen Dosojin Fire Festival: One of Japan's Great Fire Festivals — Guide
item.description: The Nozawa Onsen Dosojin Fire Festival, held every 15 January, is considered one of Japan’s three great fire festivals, a dramatic and intense nighttime spectacle centred on a huge wooden shrine (shaden) built by the villagers. In the festival’s climax, men aged 25 and 42 (considered unlucky ages) defend the structure from villagers attacking with flaming torches in a fierce battle of fire, before the shrine is finally set alight, all as a prayer for a good harvest, family wellbeing and the blessing of children, set against the deep snow of the mountain village.
